en.title: Jason Returns: New Friday the 13th Movie Casts Unknowns for 2027 Slasher
en.summary: The iconic Friday the 13th franchise is gearing up for a new installment titled "Jason," set to hit screens in 2027. The film boasts a director with franchise history and a script from an emerging writer, but its cast is largely new to horror fans.
en.body:
Crystal Lake is set to claim more victims as a new Friday the 13th film, simply titled **Jason**, is slated for a 2027 release. Stepping back into the director's chair for this latest chapter is **Steve Miner**, a veteran of the franchise who helmed both **Friday the 13th Part II** and **Part III**. The script comes from **David Fliegel**, an emerging screenwriter whose name is new to the industry, hinting at a fresh take on the enduring slasher saga.

The most striking aspect of this upcoming film is its cast, which leans heavily on actors yet to become household names in the horror genre. **Schuyler White** will don the infamous hockey mask, reprising his role as Jason Voorhees after a previous appearance in the 45th-anniversary short "Sweet Revenge." Opposite him, **Natalie Alyn Lind** is set to play the film's final girl, Lauren. Other cast members announced include **Matt Cornett** as Asher, **Lilia Buckingham** as Madison, **John Owen Lowe** as Jake, **Summer Madison** as Emily, **Selena Turner** as Olive, **Matthew Keoni Sato** as Lucas, **Brook Sill** as Zoe, **Guillermo Diaz** as Rick, **Johnell Young** as Frank, **Sencere Messiah Brown** as Chase, and **Bryan Gael Guzman** as Dylan. The ensemble also features **William Catlett** and **Devin Kessler** as siblings Levon and Brianna Brooks, adding another layer to the potential victims.

## A New Generation of Terror

This ensemble casting strategy, featuring mostly unknown actors, is a bold move for a franchise as established as Friday the 13th. It allows the filmmakers to craft new archetypes and potentially avoid audience preconceptions tied to more established stars. For fans, this presents an exciting opportunity to discover new talent and experience the terror of Jason Voorhees through fresh eyes. The choice of **Schuyler White** to return as Jason is particularly noteworthy, suggesting a continuity of vision for the character's portrayal. The inclusion of **Natalie Alyn Lind** as the final girl also sets the stage for the classic cat-and-mouse dynamic that has defined the series.

## What the Franchise Steward Says

Details surrounding the plot remain scarce, but the focus on a predominantly unknown cast suggests a desire to build suspense and let the terror speak for itself. As "franchise steward" **Robbie Barsamian** told Deadline, "We spent months thinking about how to create the scariest, most imposing Jason and who truly deserved to wear the mask." This statement implies a meticulous approach to casting, aiming to find actors who can embody the physicality and menace of the iconic killer. The lack of plot specifics only amplifies the mystery, leaving fans to speculate about the nature of Jason's return and the fate of this new group of characters.

## What's Next

With a 2027 release date on the horizon, production is expected to ramp up in the coming months. Fans will be eagerly awaiting further details on the plot and any potential trailers or sneak peeks that might emerge. The return of **Steve Miner** to direct also adds a layer of anticipation, connecting this new film to the franchise's foundational entries.

Well, imminent-ish: 2027 is just around the corner, whether we like it or not. And next year, Steve Miner (director of Friday the 13th Part 2 and Part 3 ) returns to the series to direct a movie simply called Jason . No plot details have been announced, but we do have a whole cast. Schuyler White returns to the role of Jason Voorhees after playing the character in the 45th anniversary short “Sweet Revenge.” The movie’s final girl, Lauren, will be played by Dutton Ranch ’s Natalie Alyn Lind. An announcement from Deadline includes the names of a whole handful of other characters, though without any more context (it feels safe to assume many of them are murder victims): Matt Cornett ( Every Year After ) is Asher; Lilia Buckingham ( Hocus Pocus 2 ) is Madison; John Owen Lowe ( Unstable ) is Jake; Summer Madison ( The Summer I Turned Pretty ) is Emily; Selena Turner ( Will Trent ) is Olive; Matthew Keoni Sato ( High School Musical: The Musical: The Series ) is Lucas; Brook Sill ( Stranger Things ) is Zoe; Guillermo Diaz ( Scandal ) is Rick; Johnell Young ( Wu-Tang: An American Saga ) is Frank; Sencere Messiah Brown ( Homage ) is Chase; and Bryan Gael Guzman ( Nickel Boys ) is Dylan. “Franchise steward” Robbie Barsamian told Deadline, “We spent months thinking about how to create the scariest, most imposing Jason and who truly deserved to wear the mask. Beyond his towering physical presence, we knew Schuyler understood what makes Jason tick—and that he had the work ethic and genuine respect for this franchise to get it right. He approached this theatrical feature like the role of a lifetime, packing 30 pounds of solid muscle onto his 6’5″ frame and studying the iconic Jasons who came before him so that he feels like an unstoppable force of nature. On set, we framed him low and tight, so the audience is right there in his space, looking up at him. This will be the most intimidating Jason that has ever been on screen.” Of Lind, Barsamian said, “This franchise has had many strong female leads, but her performance might just be the strongest this franchise has ever had.” The Barsamian family holds the reins of the series through their company (aptly called Horror, Inc.) and made Jason independently so they could retain full creative control. The script is by David Fliegel, whom Deadline describes as an ’emerging screenwriter’ (he has no other writing credits yet) Jason arrives in theaters on Friday, August 13th, 2027.[end-mark] The post New Friday the 13th Movie Reveals a Cast of Mostly Unknown Actors appeared first on Reactor .
